prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: horizontal editorial cover photograph for a Spanish publication about AI and work
Primary request: a night-shift data-center technician deliberately disconnects one patch cable from a rack after noticing an unexpected system behavior, showing a human stopping an automated process.
Scene/backdrop: quiet server infrastructure room with orderly cable runs and metal racks; no visible screens or labels.
Style/medium: restrained technology photojournalism, realistic proportions and fabric, subtle 35mm film grain.
Composition/framing: cinematic 16:9 landscape, technician's hand and unplugged cable in focus, racks softly receding.
Lighting/mood: low practical aisle light with a restrained red status reflection, alert and controlled rather than dramatic.
Color palette: warm near-black shadows, dark steel, small red and amber lights.
Constraints: no text, logos, watermark; realistic safe work.
Avoid: office desks, paperwork, visible screens, robots, sci-fi glow, staged stock imagery.
